details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3077-3083), _git_subprocess_env (lines 2987-2992) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The PR replaces command-scoped http.extraHeader authentication with GH_TOKEN embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs.
  WHY: Tokens appear in process arguments, Git diagnostics, `.git/config`, and model-facing tooling, violating the credential-free URL contract and existing tests.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (line 581-585), memory_ensure_branch (lines 148-180) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN and memory Git operations use bare git without the deleted `_memory_git` authentication wrapper.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, Git operations fail unauthenticated and memory writes silently fail, while credential-bearing URLs leak tokens.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path (lines 240-247), emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was deleted, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths to access credential-bearing files.
  WHY: `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, `.aws/credentials`, and similar files can be read into model prompts; the deleted symbols also break existing tests.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 49-52, 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose path bypasses the model-provider broker and runs issue-derived prompts with `--sandbox danger-full-access`.
  WHY: The model can access GH_TOKEN and OPENROUTER_API_KEY, read credentials, and mutate the workspace outside broker isolation.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 135-527 deleted; file ends at line 140 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker lifecycle and execution functions were deleted while numerous live callers remain.
  WHY: Brokered implement, plan, validate, review, consolidate, judge, triage, audit, and conflict-resolution phases exit with command-not-found before Codex starts.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: deleted `git_with_github_auth` and `review_blocked_*` helpers | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authenticated Git wrapper and review-blocked terminal-action helpers were deleted while production callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes, approval handling, successor issue preparation, and reissue-baseline pushes fail with command-not-found, preventing terminal review decisions from completing.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: removed `--provider-base-url`, hard-coded base_url at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The validated `--provider-base-url` option was removed while five callers still pass it.
  WHY: Callers exit with unknown argument before configuration is written, and the hard-coded public URL bypasses the loopback broker.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage line 7, removed `--process-group-file` handling | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The stall guard no longer accepts or records `--process-group-file` or supervises isolated process groups.
  WHY: `review_apply_fixes.sh:553` exits with unknown option before the editor starts, and orphaned isolated descendants are no longer verified or terminated.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest (lines 768-770), GraphQL block (lines 833-839, 913-924) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL comment normalizers drop id, author_id, author_type, and author_association.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval verification cannot bind producer comments or authorize approvers, leaving terminal approvals permanently pending.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 101-237 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, which are never exported or created.
  WHY: The restore is dead code on self-repo implement runs, so staged SCRIPT_REF helper copies can overwrite branch-owned edits.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `pre_assembled_static.txt` cleanup probe and restore no longer use the previous HEAD/index behavior.
  WHY: Staged artifact edits can survive into commits, while a tracked-in-HEAD file can be deleted from the worktree and committed as a deletion.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-81 and later lineage finalization | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication exported in the setup step does not reach later steps that call bare Git through memory helpers.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, lineage finalization cannot authenticate `ls-remote` or `push`, so ai-memory initialization fail-opens and telemetry is skipped.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The 256-path cap, byte accounting, omission accounting, and final-summary reserve were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`, inflate prompts, and multiply subprocess work; existing strict-bounds tests fail.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 203-204 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` arguments pass current=editor, other=staged_base, base=HEAD instead of current=editor, other=HEAD, base=staged_base.
  WHY: The three-way merge uses the wrong common ancestor and can silently drop branch-side changes or produce incorrect conflict markers.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30 and 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection fails with ImportError before assertions run.

- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py: lines 95-143 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Existing tests still require the credential-free URL contract, `_memory_git`, and review-blocked approval helpers.
  WHY: CI assertion and subprocess failures occur because the PR removed the pinned production behavior.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: ensure_diagnose_asset at lines 373-375 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose asset loader still has a `.codex-workflow-src-main` mutable-main fallback.
  WHY: Helper code can still execute from a moving main ref while GH_TOKEN is present, preserving the mutable-code trust-boundary risk.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, agents.md | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Public helper APIs, CLI flags, module symbols, and the documented broker contract were removed without aliases or documentation updates.
  WHY: Live callers fail, tests break, and agents.md describes security guarantees and interfaces that no longer exist.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py, tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py, tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py, tests/test_model_provider_broker.py | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Existing test suites directly pin deleted production symbols and behaviors, but the PR does not update them.
  WHY: CI fails through ImportError, assertion failures, and subprocess command-not-found errors.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add repository-wide regression coverage to prevent mutable action or helper references from returning."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py or a new contract test
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py adds setup-uv and free-disk-space SHA assertions, but no new coverage verifies the mutable-code patterns in ai_memory_lib.py and memory_helpers.sh (URL-embedded tokens).

- requirement: Fix every instance of the mutable stable/main helper-fallback defect class across sibling paths, not only the cited issue_pr_status.yml lines.
  expected_change_site: scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh ensure_diagnose_asset at 373-375
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: The PR removes stable/main fallbacks from issue_pr_status.yml and updates review_autofix staging tests, but ensure_diagnose_asset still copies assets from `.codex-workflow-src-main` while GH_TOKEN is present.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  PROBLEM: The PR replaces per-command http.extraHeader authentication with GH_TOKEN embedded directly in HTTPS clone URLs (x-access-token:TOKEN@github.com/...).
  WHY: Tokens appear in /proc/<pid>/cmdline, Git error messages, .git/config, and the existing security contract test at test_git_auth_hygiene.py:51-55.

  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN directly and memory_ensure_branch now uses bare git ls-remote/push without authentication.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false, bare Git calls fail silently and credential-bearing URLs leak through process arguments and tooling.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py; normalize_path (lines 240-247), removed is_sensitive_target_path and MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The sensitive-path filter was deleted.
  WHY: Issue- or plan-derived paths can read and inline .git/config, .env*, .ssh/id_rsa, .aws/credentials, and similar credential files; existing imports also fail.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh; line 668 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The diagnose path switched from model_provider_broker_exec_sanitized to direct codex --sandbox danger-full-access execution.
  WHY: Issue-derived prompts execute with unrestricted workspace access while GH_TOKEN and OPENROUTER_API_KEY remain available.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh; lines 135-527 deleted | severity=BLO
